## Feature Summary
A brief and clear description of the feature.

## Motivation
Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Design
A description of the expected behavior or implementation approach.

## Acceptance Criteria
Criteria that define a successful and correct implementation.

## Related Issues / Discussions
Links to related issues or discussions, along with context if necessary.

## Implementation Notes (Optional)
Notes for developers and suggested approaches or solutions.

## Localization & Accessibility
Explain whether additional translation or specific accessibility features are required.

## Community Feedback (Optional)
Mention any user feedback or suggestions outside of linked issues and discussions.
